## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows `type(scope): subject`
- [ ] Small and focused (about 100 lines; refactors in their own PR)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass locally
- [ ] Docs, README or ADR updated where behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data or non-ASCII text in source files
- [ ] AI review run and findings addressed
- [ ] Self-review of the full diff done
